newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Stage Stores said attractive.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Stage Stores said attractive.

text.p: -- Stage Stores Inc was started with an attractive rating on Wednesday by Bear Stearns, according to a source at the firm.
-- Analyst Mark Picard was not immediately available for comment.
-- Bear Stearns was one of the underwriters of the company's October 25 initial public offering.

-- Picard later confirmed the rating. He said he gave the stock a 12-month price target of $26 a share and said Stage Stores is well-positioned for strong growth by "offering branded apparel to small-town America."
